verdict.rationale: Apify's SDK documents a SessionPool that manages cookies and other custom settings alongside proxy IP rotation, so cookie state can carry across requests within a crawl. It also supports Playwright and Puppeteer browser automation. However, nothing in the evidence describes a persistent browser profile (user-data directory) or saved login state that is reused across separate runs. Missing for 10: explicit persistent browser profile/user-data-dir support, documented login-state reuse across runs, hands-on or independent corroboration.
